steps.action: Reload the browser page (F5). Return to the Orders area.

steps.action: Place an order: account A1001, side Sell, instrument RY, quantity 1.
steps.expected: The order is rejected because 0 shares are available; the list still shows two Open sell orders (70 and 30).

steps.action: Open the Portfolio area.
steps.expected: RY in A1001 still shows quantity 100.
